quest.title: A Special Blend, A Timeless Masterpiece
quest.description: After running the drinks stand for a while, your creations have received widespread acclaim and are about to become new classics...

talks.objective: Talk to Varka and the others

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey there, {NICKNAME}! All wrapped up for the day?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon hears you did a great job holding down the fort while she was out delivering drinks with Glenfidia!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...Whatever the reason, the Honorary Knight is clearly one of the most talented mixologists in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: #Considering how short a time {M#he's}{F#she's} been doing this, I believe that someday, {M#he}{F#she} has the potential to give the legendary bartender at The Cat's Tail a run for her money.

response.speaker: Glenfidia
response.text: I fully support your decision, Grand Master. The Honorary Knight has really put in the hard yards.

response.speaker: Glenfidia
response.text: The drinks stand will remain open for a little while longer to provide a proper welcome to our returning expedition members. Then, once we locate suitable premises, we also plan to look at operating a permanent service...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hooray! Everyone in the Knights of Favonius will get to drink all the delicious cocktails they like!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Nothing short of what I'd expect from a true disciple of Hertha. You've really considered this thoroughly, Glenfidia!

response.speaker: Glenfidia
response.text: Also, if I may, Honorary Knight, regarding the special cocktails you've developed... Would you mind leaving the recipes with us? We'd like to add them to the official menu.

choices.text: Of course! That way, everyone can try them!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Paimon feels like there's something you still want to say... Let Paimon have a guess...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Based on your personality, you probably want... to introduce the origin of each different cocktail!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That way, customers will know who inspired you to create these amazing drinks!

choices.text: Right on the Mora! You know me so well, Paimon!

response.speaker: Glenfidia
response.text: No problem at all! If you need, I can even have someone draft the paperwork on your behalf to secure you the rights to these new recipes.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Haha, I hope when we recruit some new bartenders, they'll be able to learn from your incredible skills...

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Even if they can't quite match your work, if they can be two-thirds as good, that would still make them industry leaders!

choices.text: I think that's what everyone would want, right?
It would be selfish not to!
I got some great ideas from chatting with everyone!
